evaluations.reason: The specification adds a project-aware preset inventory flow and tree rendering from plugin registry data, but it does not define explicit bounds for recursive traversal, number of presets, or loaded registry size; it lacks any upper-limit guard for recursive/bulk processing and includes no matched exception rationale.
